messages:
nicole: quick check on hosting-adapter boundaries. posted a tiny sketch (gist) with breakpoints. main open Q: who owns tenant KMS unwrap for Private?

omar: sketch looks sane. vote: adapter performs local KMS unwrap and returns a scoped runtime claim to control plane (no raw keys leaving customer infra).

tarun: +1 for isolation. control plane must verify provenance. propose AttestationV1 blob: adapter_id | nonce | expiry | sig (sig by adapter onboarding key). control plane validates pubkey.

nicole: also require handshake_version and capability_manifest_v. keep manifest minimal and opaque. sample entries: "batching:max=32","kv_cache:ttl=3600","streaming:true","max_seq:4096". prefer simple typed strings over nested structs.

omar: error semantics: canonicalize small set: ERR_CAPACITY, ERR_TEMP_OVERLOAD, ERR_AUTH, ERR_UNSUPPORTED_OP. adapters include retry_after secs and optional rate_hint to avoid retry storms.

tarun: telemetry: runtime sees token deltas. for Private/on-prem customers that block outbound, adapters should support local sinks (push to prom endpoint) and produce signed aggregate counters (token_count, requests) for reconciliation. counters must be numeric-only, include monotonic nonce to prevent replay.

sec-bot: Created INF-1801: "Adapter isolation + handshake" and linked this thread.

nicole: implementation plan: omar -> shim prototype with handshake types + attestation helper (ETA 2w), tarun -> security appendix + key-rotation notes (ETA 3d), nicole -> RFC update with boundary diagram, capability manifest shape, error list, telemetry constraints (ETA 2d). ping here with PR links.

omar: will prototype minimal shim and example sig verification.

tarun: will draft appendix and threat model.

nicole: small ops note: mandate handshake_version and manifest_v and specify a compatibility grace window. also require adapters to surface a compact capability summary so control plane can route without leaking internal runtime structs.

omar: agree. fallback policy: control plane owns fallback decisions but adapters must return stable error codes so decisions are deterministic.

tarun: ack. nothing blocking.

nicole: thanks all 10. closing until PRs show up.
